text:
Type: articulated clamp-on work lamp
Use: task light for working, reading or crafts at a desk; home office, study, workshop
Style: industrial, retro, modern
Materials: silver-painted steel shade with vent slots, spring-balanced steel arms, black clamp base, black cord
Colors: silver grey, black
Shape: deep dome shade on a long jointed arm with exposed springs, clamps to a desk edge, adjustable and angular, medium visual weight
Feel: practical, studious, mechanical, classic
Goes with: wooden or white desks, grey and black accents, pegboards; industrial or modern home offices

product.name: TERTIAL
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
